description: Gares et stations du réseau ferré is a dataset listed in Sèvres - Open data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Gares et stations de transport ferré (RER, métros, tramways, transiliens) autour de la ville de Sèvres. Coverage: Sèvres. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité. Its keywords are Réseau ferré, Lignes, Plateforme numérique, Collectivité. The portal shows 34 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-12-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-sevres-seineouest-portal.
